data.name: Bitcoin District
data.description: Bitcoin District is a community of Bitcoiners in the DC, Maryland & Virginia (DMV) area. They network, socialize, and learn from one another, united by belief in Bitcoin, freedom, and sovereignty. The site hosts an events calendar (Luma, iCal), meetups (Ballston Happy Hour, Coffee & Bitcoin, 757BTC), a monthly book club, and the Bitcoin District Initiative 501(c)(3) for advancing adoption in the DMV.

data.name: Bitcoin District Initiative
data.description: The Bitcoin District Initiative empowers DC residents, small businesses, and community organizations through Bitcoin education and advocacy. A 501(c)(3) tax-exempt nonprofit (EIN 39-2961184), they help people accept payments, save securely, and use Bitcoin with confidence through local workshops and one-on-one support. Kickoff projects: 100 Businesses Accepting BTC by 2026 (onboarding DC-area merchants for a thriving circular economy) and Local Business Surveys (gathering insights from 50 DC businesses by end of 2025). They put businesses on the BTC Map and publish guides on taxes, Square integration, and onboarding. Bitcoin-only nonprofit. Visit BitcoinDistrict.org to join the community.

data.name: DMV Women & Bitcoin
data.description: DMV Women & Bitcoin brings together women working in or curious about Bitcoin. They share real experiences, career paths, and lessons learned, with a focus on how women contribute to building, securing, and supporting Bitcoin—from technical roles to adjacent fields. Panel discussions cover navigating the industry, building careers in emerging tech, and what it's really like to work in Bitcoin-focused organizations. Bitcoin-only focus.

data.name: Satoshi Action Fund
data.description: The Satoshi Action Fund is the Bitcoin advocacy organization. They work with lawmakers and regulators to ensure Bitcoin, Bitcoin mining, and digital assets can positively impact the environment, grid, economy, and society. Track record: 20M+ Americans protected, 9 laws passed, 2,000+ lawmakers educated, 20+ hearings with public testimony. They believe all Americans should have the opportunity to benefit from Bitcoin technology.

data.name: Unchained
data.description: Unchained helps you secure Bitcoin with cold storage you control, plus trading, inheritance, loans, and IRAs. Thousands of individuals and businesses secure over $10 billion of Bitcoin with Unchained. Services include multisig vaults, withdrawal from exchanges, upgrading from singlesig, trading desk (buy Bitcoin straight to your vault), commercial loans, Bitcoin IRA, inheritance planning, and business vaults. Unchained Signature offers white-glove concierge. Customer support is central to all services.

data.name: Sovreign
data.description: Sovreign helps businesses build with better money—understand, integrate, and manage Bitcoin with confidence. Their end-to-end services include Education (keynotes, workshops), Strategy (dedicated advisors, customized solutions), and Technical Support (treasury management, multisig setup). They partner with Coinkite, River, Theya, and Unchained to offer white-glove self-custody onboarding and Business Vaults with 2-of-3 multisig. Based at Strategy Hub, Tysons Corner, VA.

data.name: The Bitcoin Commons
data.description: The Bitcoin Commons enables coordination without authority—an architectural solution applying proven commons management principles (Elinor Ostrom's Nobel Prize-winning research) to Bitcoin's development layer. Two complementary innovations: BLVM (Bitcoin Low-Level Virtual Machine) provides mathematical rigor through the Orange Paper, formal verification, and a compiler-like architecture enabling safe alternative implementations; Bitcoin Commons provides forkable governance through cryptographic enforcement and a 5-tier constitutional model. BTCDecoded is the first complete implementation. Governance forks don't affect Bitcoin consensus—all nodes validate the same blockchain but can use different governance rules. Users can fork governance rulesets to create exit competition if governance is captured.

data.name: Endless Mining
data.description: Endless Mining is the crypto mining marketplace with endless opportunities. They offer ASIC miners, hosting services, and mining consulting. Their marketplace features everything from new and used Bitcoin miners (Bitmain Antminer, Goldshell, Fluminer) to miner hosting at competitive rates ($0.08–$0.077/kWh). They help customers stay ahead in the rapidly evolving cryptocurrency mining industry.

data.name: Second Gate
data.description: Second Gate is a boutique advisory firm offering tailored services with a dual focus: advising growth companies and assisting investors in navigating the digital asset industry. They help clients make timely, data-driven decisions across every layer of the Bitcoin ecosystem—from strategy and execution to M&A support, financial analysis, due diligence, and deal sourcing. Co-founders bring over $1B in transaction experience and decades in Bitcoin mining (Galaxy Digital, Fidelity, Terawulf).

data.name: Simple Proof
data.description: Simple Proof protects digital records and documents with the power of Bitcoin. Their immutable proof service timestamps digital documents using open protocols (OpenTimestamps), delivering enterprise-scale document integrity. In 2024, Screven County, Georgia became the first in the U.S. to use Bitcoin's blockchain to secure election results through Simple Proof. They offer fingerprinting, Bitcoin timestamping, and verification—all permissionless and interoperable. AWS Qualified Software.

data.name: Bitcoin Comms
data.description: Low time preference PR and communications services for Bitcoin and freedom-focused technology projects.

data.name: Bitvault
data.description: BitVault is your fortress against physical attacks and hacks, employing time-delayed transactions over multisig against a trustless convenience service to shield your Bitcoin. 100% open source, non-custodial, zero counterparty risk. Features include multisig security, customizable time delays (2 hours–15 days), physical attack protection, hack prevention, and integration with major hardware wallets (Keystone, Jade, Seedsigner, Passport). Natively integrated with Bitcoin L2s. Pre-sale available.

data.name: Carbon Country
data.description: Carbon Country combines food, energy, carbon, and BTC. They're transforming small and underutilized farms by combining agrivoltaics (solar over rotationally grazed pasture), carbon removal, and cryptocurrency mining. Selling certified organic halal lamb and beef, carbon removal/avoidance credits, and maximizing returns through energy storage arbitrage, grid sales, and BTC mining. 73-acre pilot farm acquired May 2024; $8.4M C-Pace financing and $2.8M in grants in progress. Empowering rural and historically disadvantaged communities.

data.name: 21Allies
data.description: 21 Allies connects the Bitcoin industry. Services include Advisory (solve problems, connect the dots, board experience), Payment & Banking (reliable partners), Fundraising (investor network), Brand Strategy, PR, and Digital Marketing. They bring years of experience to help Bitcoin companies grow and navigate the ecosystem.

data.name: Bitcoin Prophets
data.description: Bitcoin Prophets is a Bitcoin investment fund combined with an apparel, education, lifestyle, and community brand. The fund's main objective is accumulating Bitcoin as the reserve asset while deploying capital toward equities in the Bitcoin space. Mission: harness Bitcoin's power to change the world, liberate humanity from broken monetary systems, and position investors to thrive. Features include a shop (Bitcoin and Christ gear), library, podcast, and blog.

data.name: Commonwealth Cyber Initiative
data.description: The Commonwealth Cyber Initiative (CCI) is Virginia's main access point for cybersecurity research, innovation, workforce development, and news. Researchers find funding and collaboration, students discover career possibilities, and new innovations come to life. CCI funds projects, runs workforce development (including clearance preparedness), and connects the Northern Virginia, Central Virginia, Coastal Virginia, and Southwest Virginia nodes. Hub members contribute Bitcoin-specific research.

data.name: Geeks of the Valley
data.description: Geeks of the Valley is a podcast featuring the brightest minds and visionary thinkers transforming the global economy. Long-form discussions with industry trailblazers in VC, blockchain, crypto, and fintech. Services include a network of early-stage startups and top VCs, podcast production, and a newsletter with deal flow and weekly insights. Featured guests include Anthony Scaramucci, Avichal Garg (Electric Capital), and Hassan Ahmed (Coinbase).

data.name: Lightning.news
data.description: Lightning News covers breaking Bitcoin and Lightning Network stories. News, events, economics, policy, adoption, Lightning wallets, guides, and interviews. Categories include Lightning Leaders, Bitcoin adoption, innovation, and more.
